svg.title: slow subscriber policies
svg.desc: Blocking publish waits for channel capacity. Nonblocking publish skips a full channel and counts a drop. Blocking sends also delay unsubscribe.
svg.text: Slow subscribers: wait or skip the full buffer
Subscriber buffer capacity = 1; E1 is queued and E2 is being published.
[E1] full -> sending E2 waits -> subscriber reads E1 -> E2 enters buffer
[E1] full -> E2 is dropped for this subscriber -> publisher continues
Blocking sends hold the subscription lock, so unsubscribe waits for that send to finish.
Both policies visit subscribers sequentially. A blocked send delays later deliveries.
